card.line: Massah was a place in the wilderness where Israel tested the LORD by doubting Him, and the name became a warning to remember.

moments.title: Water from the rock
moments.text: God told Moses He would stand by the rock at Horeb, and water would come out when Moses struck it. Moses did this in front of the elders of Israel.

moments.title: A name for the quarrel
moments.text: Moses named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and tested the LORD, asking, "Is the LORD among us or not?"

moments.title: Levi tested at Massah
moments.text: Moses said that God tested His godly one at Massah and contested with him at the waters of Meribah. This was part of Moses' blessing on Levi.
